race.comment: LONGINUS (6) was a nice winner over this trip at Hawkesbury two back in a Class 1 before a sound effort in a small field at Kembla Grange, perhaps just outsprinted there. Drawn wide but that will ensure Zac Lloyd rolls along and makes them run him down. MAJORIAN (1) was behind LONGINUS at Kembla Grange having just missed there prior. Rock hard fit and will stay this out strongly. TACITLY (3) has just found one better in all three starts this time in. Just missed at Newcastle last time in a Class 1 and sets up nicely to go one better. SIR TUA (10) finished eighth last start, beaten 3.5 lengths at Newcastle over 1880m. Value at odds
